source.title: Genuine Quantum Strong Mpemba Effect by Eliminating Coherence

genuine_novelty: The source reports a controllable optical implementation simulating a Davies map and a single-qubit strong-Mpemba effect by removing relevant coherence when the slowest decay modes are degenerate and purely coherent.
limitations: Minimal single-qubit optical simulation of an open-system map; not a scalable processor or commercial thermal engine.
Relaxation-time improvement does not imply lower wall-plug energy, heat, entropy production, work cost, accepted-task time, or financial cost.
Preparation, control, readout, reset, retries, output quality, and full system resource overheads remain to be measured or explicitly marked unavailable.
No independent UQPU reproduction, physical experiment, real-QPU job, or economic result was produced.

work_item.objective: Test whether the reported relaxation benefit survives matched accepted-output criteria and complete preparation/control/readout/reset/retry accounting.
acceptance_contract: Freeze source version, model parameters, initial states, observables, relaxation metric, acceptance threshold, and data/code hashes.
Independently reproduce the single-qubit Davies-map dynamics and compare against analytic or exact small-system reference where available.
Use held-out generator parameters and initial states with null controls.
Record t_prep, t_control, t_relax, t_readout, t_reset, retries, accepted-output quality, uncertainty, and energy terms separately.
Reject mission-level benefit if the effect fails independent reproduction, held-out tests, or total-overhead accounting.
work_item.falsifier: The relaxation-only advantage disappears after preparation/control/readout/reset/retry overheads, does not generalize to held-out parameters, changes accepted output, or fails independent reproduction.
non_claims: No material, bio-oil, fusion, financing, or Data-Center-to-Phone result.
